public_runtime_contract.threading: one public handle is runtime-serialized; direct internal runtime access is not independently thread-safe

recall_control.shadow: the deterministic System-One controller plans once per recall after the default planner executes; the result gains an optional recall_control telemetry block (request, response, usage, routes_executed, route_candidate_counts, shadow_delta, actual_stop); candidates, admission, ranking and returned are identical to off

source_ref.validation: non-empty string, at most 256 characters; not settable through overrides
source_ref.use: recorded in the fact's immutable write_provenance; read only by the cross-fact guard set (same declared source)

proposition.default: None (no typed proposition; the 1.0.0 interpreted path applies)
proposition.shape: {subject, attribute, value, assertion: state|change, cardinality: single|multi|null, replaces_value, flags: {hedged, attributed_to_other, conditional, negated, joke_or_sarcasm, quoted_or_forwarded, coexistent}}; strings non-empty, at most 200 characters, no control characters; enums and flag keys closed; each flag defaults to false
proposition.use: persisted as write-time evidence in write_semantics.typed_proposition with basis caller_declared; outranks any extractor, which is then not called
proposition.acceptance: unaccepted until the docs/plan-732-remediation.md R6 acceptance PR (advisory V1)

proposition_extractor.opt_in: passing an extractor is the handle's per-handle opt-in to data egress; the extractor must carry a caller-supplied egress_policy(text) -> bool with no default
proposition_extractor.egress: for each remember without a caller-declared proposition, the new text and up to eight retained candidate texts admitted by the writer's own governed recall are sent to the extractor's provider, subject to egress_policy (a refused new text is not sent and persists typed_proposition null with reason egress_refused; a refused candidate is dropped)
proposition_extractor.persistence: computed once and persisted with the fact (basis extracted:<id>@<version>, raw provider output, request id, candidate uuids, prompt sha256); never recomputed; recovery never calls an extractor
proposition_extractor.failure: provider error, 20 s timeout or schema-invalid output persists typed_proposition null with a typed reason; the write always commits
proposition_extractor.acceptance: unaccepted until the docs/plan-732-remediation.md R6 acceptance PR (advisory V1)

canonical_json_v2.migration_posture: verify_before_recommit; side-effect-free preflight; transactional recommit only on verified disposable copy

write_semantics.self_validity: bounded and anchored only by caller-declared observed_at; may limit, never affirm currentness
write_semantics.proposal_application: explicit caller action through governed lifecycle; never automatic

typed_proposition.typed_slot: typed:<norm(subject)>|<norm(attribute)>; norm lower-cases, collapses whitespace and strips edge punctuation; no stemming, no synonym table
typed_proposition.classifier_version: 1.1.0 only for a write that carries a typed proposition; every other write keeps classifier 1.0.0 and its persisted version tag, so its stored bytes are unchanged
typed_proposition.relation_bases: typed_slot, typed_link (updates_fact_uuid confirmed deterministically at write time), typed_link_unconfirmed (unresolved; never a proposal)
typed_proposition.state_change_candidate_rule: assertion change, cardinality not multi, every flag false, values differ; typed_ineligible_reasons (untrusted_self_claim; hedged by typed flag or lexical hedge scan) non-empty gives unresolved and no proposal
typed_proposition.null_typed_proposition: extraction failure, egress refusal or extractor off takes the unchanged 1.0.0 interpreted path
typed_proposition.proposal_application: explicit caller action through governed lifecycle; never automatic
typed_proposition.acceptance: unaccepted until the docs/plan-732-remediation.md R6 acceptance PR (advisory V1); the v6 acceptance evidence measures the extractor-off default only

read_semantics.canonical_admission: single governed admission boundary after candidate union
read_semantics.explicit_current_unknown_basis: time-neutral normalized-content fallback for genuine relevance ties; applicable-over-unknown only inside persisted typed exclusive competition
read_semantics.lexical_anti_laundering: candidate-specific masking only for high-risk persisted self-claims and high-confidence consumed temporal-intent spans

return_budget.rule: returned is the ranked prefix of the admitted set at k; admitted stays whole and is counted; a call without a budget returns exactly what contract 1.3.0 returned

semantic_route.ordering: subordinate: semantic-only candidates order after every relevance and temporal stage; the route never counts toward corroboration and never moves a lexical score (ranking policy 3.2.0; unchanged in 3.3.0 and 3.4.0)
semantic_route.off_equivalence: with no semantic hit, 3.2.0 orders exactly as 3.1.2 (reference/tests/test_semantic_route_policy_320.py); the facade default opens no representation provider and writes no derived store

representation.provider: pinned local ONNX export, optional extra 'semantic' (decision-embedding-dependency)
representation.config_digest_scope: binds every model file digest, the numerics settings and the onnxruntime, tokenizers and numpy versions pinned by reference/requirements-semantic.txt

semantic_route.eligibility: the same domain-eligibility prefilter as the lexical route

recall_control.actual_stop: describes the default planner's execution: no_evidence, frontier_exhausted, or max_candidates (resource) when the semantic host cap of 16 binds; never a controller quality judgement
recall_control.failure: controller unavailable or invalid response leaves recall unchanged (fallback_events: controller_failure_no_effect)
recall_control.enforcement: none: budgets, deadlines and adaptive stopping are T-controller-2

cross_fact_currentness.policy: ExplicitCurrentCrossFactRankingPolicy 3.4.0 (explicit_current_interpreted_cross_fact_v1); the ranking stages are 3.3.0's, only the evidence the guards admit changes
cross_fact_currentness.applies_to: explicit-current recall only (caller-declared or query_language_explicit); historical, as-of, atemporal and inferred recalls are identical to 3.2.0 apart from policy identity
cross_fact_currentness.label: limited_by_cross_fact_state_change (basis interpreted_cross_fact, evidence cross_fact_limitation)
cross_fact_currentness.condition: a newer admitted fact carries an open, unapplied write-time state_change_candidate proposal against the older fact and guards G1-G13 hold (same actor, same declared source, same scope, direct observations, assertive first-party change sentence, no contradicting declared clock) under assertion filter 6.1.0: interpreted relations pass G3, G6 and G12 exactly as under 6.0.0; a typed_slot or typed_link relation passes G3 only with a caller_declared or extracted:* typed proposition, G6 reads its typed_ineligible_reasons, and G12 reads its persisted typed flags (any true flag refuses with typed_assertion_not_assertive:<flag>) without re-checking the text
cross_fact_currentness.effect: the older fact is demoted inside the existing temporal_applicability_tier stage; it stays admitted and returned; nothing is mutated and the proposal stays open (Option D not implemented)
cross_fact_currentness.refusal: cross_fact_refusal_reason (first failing guard) under explicit-current intent only
cross_fact_currentness.typed_relations: unaccepted until the docs/plan-732-remediation.md R6 acceptance PR (advisory V1); with the extractor off and no caller declaration no typed relation exists
